'''''The Last Order''''' is a young-adult novel  written by [[Kwame Mbalia]], and released as a tie-in to the 10th anniversary of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'']]. The novel was published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] on [[October 21]], [[2025]] alongside an [[The Last Order (audiobook)|audiobook version]].
